children: CF Industries agreed to acquire the Faustina ammonia facility and related assets for $600 million, with plans to boost production.
The deal includes the Louisiana facility and storage and logistics assets; $240 million is allocated to a long-term ammonia offtake agreement.
CF Industries expects to fund $360 million with cash on hand and invest about $100 million over three years in facility improvements.
Production is expected to reach 480,000 tons annually within the first year after closing and approximately 570,000 tons by 2030.
The company estimates the improvements could make about 270,000 additional tons of ammonia available annually for fertilizer and other consumers.
The transaction is expected to preserve about 50 Louisiana manufacturing jobs and remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
